question: Does replacing the stack's final isotonic calibration with centred isotonic regression, which keeps the calibration but not the staircase, raise pooled out-of-fold AUROC without losing calibration or detection at an alarm budget?
mechanism: Isotonic regression maps the meta-learner's score through a staircase (22 steps on the deployed stack), so hours on one step tie and the ranking made inside the step is discarded. Centred isotonic regression (Oron & Flournoy 2017; backend/ml/models/calibration.py centred_transform) interpolates through each step's centre, taken as the midpoint of the step's raw-score span from the fitted thresholds, with a 1e-7 tie-break slope beyond the outer centres.
detector: the shipped configuration, patient:hgb+hgb2+et+lr+xgb@utility, one fit per fold; every arm reads the same fitted stack and differs only in the final map

arms.centred: centred isotonic regression from the same fitted isotonic map (the candidate)
arms.sigmoid: Platt scaling fitted on the same calibration slice (secondary)

primary_endpoint: delta pooled OOF AUROC (centred - isotonic); paired patient bootstrap, 1,000 draws (multinomial patient counts as row weights, one draw shared by all arms); 95% interval.
budget_guard: no significant regression in detection at 5/10/15/20% alarm budgets (bench.compare_alarm_budget, metrics.budget_threshold, 1,000 paired patient draws; regression = 95% interval upper bound < 0)
decision_rule: SUCCESS iff the primary interval's lower bound > 0 AND the safety rule holds AND no budget regresses. A success licenses registering a promotion of the calibrator; it ships nothing by itself.
secondary: per-fold AUROC deltas (pooled AUROC is reported beside them, per the stacking-test lesson)
the sigmoid arm on the same endpoints
disclosures: On the deployed artifact (a single 5,996-patient fit) scored on 6,852 unseen patients: raw meta score AUROC 0.7476 vs isotonic 0.7425, hour-matched 0.6445 vs 0.6383. Centred isotonic has not been scored anywhere.
Any strictly increasing map ranks exactly like the raw score within a fold, so within-fold AUROC(centred) = AUROC(raw); the pooled endpoint also depends on how each fold's map scales its scores.
rules: No arm, endpoint or bar changes after the run.
The result is reported whatever it is.
